title: Chick reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- chick body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- chick head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='18' fill='#FFE45C'/>
  <!-- tuft -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q48 12 54 16 Q52 20 50 20Z' fill='#FFC300'/>
  <path d='M50 20 Q54 14 58 18 Q54 21 50 20Z' fill='#FFA600'/>
  <!-- wings holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFC300' transform='rotate(-25 30 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='62' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFC300' transform='rotate(25 70 62)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='36' y='58' width='28' height='20' rx='2' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <rect x='36' y='58' width='5' height='20' fill='#B7332C'/>
  <rect x='59' y='58' width='5' height='20' fill='#B7332C'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='64' x2='48' y2='64' stroke='#FFF3C4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='69' x2='48' y2='69' stroke='#FFF3C4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='64' x2='59' y2='64' stroke='#FFF3C4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='69' x2='59' y2='69' stroke='#FFF3C4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes looking down at book -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#2C2C54'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#2C2C54'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='41' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M47 46 L53 46 L50 51 Z' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <path d='M47 46 L53 46 L50 48.5 Z' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M42 83 L38 89 M42 83 L42 90 M42 83 L46 89' stroke='#FFA600' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 83 L54 89 M58 83 L58 90 M58 83 L62 89' stroke='#FFA600' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
